page_title: ROM 0-1 INT | AS Roma v Inter 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) touches the ball with his hand.

90+2' What a poor attempt! Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
90+1' 16:26 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' What an opportunity! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
88' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gets inside the box and tries to beat Yann Sommer with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
87' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
86' Manuel Akanji (Inter) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
86' Petar Sucic (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
84' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
81' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Federico Dimarco and he is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
81' Here's the change. Nicolo Barella leaves the pitch and Piotr Zielinski (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
80' Federico Dimarco (Inter) makes a slide tackle, but referee Davide Massa blows for a foul. AS Roma earn a free kick.
80' Here is a change. Matias Soule is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Evan Ferguson (AS Roma).
79' Petar Sucic (Inter) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
77' Federico Dimarco (Inter) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
74' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
74' That's the end of the game for Mario Hermoso, who is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
73' Substitution. Paulo Dybala is replaced by Leon Bailey (AS Roma).
73' It's like he was asking for a caution. Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) receives a yellow card.
73' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
71' Nicolo Barella (Inter) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
71' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mile Svilar scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
70' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
69' Substitution. Petar Sucic (Inter) replaces Ange-Yoan Bonny.
68' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
67' A precise low pass is received by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:8. 4:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.

66' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Inter win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' Matias Soule (AS Roma) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer is equal to it and makes an easy save.
62' The foul by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
61' Hakan Calhanoglu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
61' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Lautaro Martinez is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
59' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
59' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
59' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
58' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) replaces Evan Ndicka.
55' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) replaces Lorenzo Pellegrini.

55' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Yann Sommer denies him with a great save.
53' Handball by Francesco Acerbi (Inter). AS Roma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
53' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
53' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

52' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Yann Sommer anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Now AS Roma have a corner.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
51' An attempted cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off a brilliant save.
50' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) leaps to meet the corner from Hakan Calhanoglu, but plants his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
47' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
44' Inter are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) and Ange-Yoan Bonny try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
37' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
36' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Davide Massa blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
35' Manuel Akanji (Inter) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
32' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
31' 3:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 0:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
30' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Zeki Celik, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
30' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
27' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Paulo Dybala, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
27' The referee awards a corner and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take it.
24' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
23' Lautaro Martinez nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
21' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Referee Davide Massa sees the trip by Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
17' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) evades his marker in the box and connects beautifully with the corner from Paulo Dybala. Unfortunately for him, the ball just zips a few inches over the bar.
13' Corner kick. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Wesley Franca, but Yann Sommer displays great awareness to stop him.

10' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Mile Svilar and his nice save.
9' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
8' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
8' Nicolo Barella (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.

6' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Nicolo Barella, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter), who beats Mile Svilar with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
3' Nicolo Barella (Inter) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ange-Yoan Bonny. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
1' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
